thread:
brynn: quick sync — Acme pilot asking for prewarm + HSM integration for pilot launch end-of-month. We don't have the security signoff or runtime prewarm hooks in place. proposing two paths: (A) ship minimal prewarm + soft HSM mock for pilot (reduced SLA), (B) delay to implement full KMS/HSM + prewarm infra. Which way do we want to push?

michael: my read — runtime can add prewarm hook (~2w) but it's blocked by infra quota and security review for HSM. If we do mock HSM we can demo but risk rework.

zoe: infra constraints: GPU pool autoscale config can support prewarm, but reservation + dedicated nodes for Acme will need commit from finance. 2w estimate for config + testing.

brynn: tradeoffs noted. product preference is demoability for partner kickoff but we must be explicit about degraded SLAs. devon, what's Acme's tolerance?

devon: Acme will accept a demo with caveats for the first week, but legal asked for at-rest encryption proof. They might sign a PTA only if HSM is in scope.

aisha: security: HSM integration and audit logs are non-negotiable for the legal ask. We can provision a temporary KMS-backed flow with strict audit retention as a stopgap, but HSM still needs time for key rotation policy + pen test — estimate 3w.

alex: ops-sre: if we go with mock HSM + prewarm we need a clear rollback plan and a traffic cap. Also need a canary route and alerting on token-rate and cache saturation. I can own the canary + alerts.

brynn: propose hybrid: ship prewarm runtime (2w) + temporary KMS-backed encryption (2w parallel) with explicit pilot SLA doc and a hard target to finish HSM in 3w post-demo. Who can own the pilot SLA doc and customer comms?

michael: runtime team can own the prewarm work. alex owns canary. aisha will lead security plan and signoff timeline.

devon: I’ll draft pilot SLA + customer comms and call it out in the kickoff. Brynn pls review before send.

zoe: infra action item — I will open a capacity request and cost estimate today, tag @finance.

ops-bot: reminder — new ticket created: INFRA-4321 "Acme pilot reservation + prewarm" assigned to zoe.

brynn: thanks. final ask — team, confirm blockers by EOD and we’ll lock on hybrid path if there are no fatal objections. :thumbsup:

michael: +1

aisha: +1

alex: +1 (will post the canary runbook later)

devon: +1 (will share SLA draft by 12pm PST)

zoe: +1 (capacity req in INFRA-4321)
